correctness.rationale: Exact decomposition into the two eigenspaces of the commuting Pauli involution \(R\) turns the positive block into Strang splitting and the negative block into identity. Direct Taylor expansion gives the nonzero cubic coefficient, and a telescoping unitary bound gives global \(O(t^3/r^2)\). Minimality follows because with at most three distinct Pauli directions every nonzero pair commutator lies in a distinct Hilbert–Schmidt-orthogonal Pauli direction, so the quadratic BCH sum cannot cancel.

value.rationale: The theorem supplies a sharp smallest-term structural boundary for ordering-induced order elevation in Pauli Trotterization, directly complementing recent work that treats ordering as an optimization variable. It distinguishes a deterministic algebraic cancellation from randomization, averaging, or standard symmetric half-step formulas.
